question: what is the roi in snap-on if the investment was made at the end of 2005 and sold at the end of 2007?
reasoning: We need ROI from end of 2005 to end of 2007. Need stock prices? The document gives fiscal year-end per share price: 2005 $37.56, 2007 $48.13. Also dividends paid per share: 2006 $1.08, 2007 $1.11. ROI = (ending price + dividends received - beginning price) / beginning price. Assuming investment at end of 2005, sold at end of 2007, received dividends in 2006 and 2007. So total return = (48.13 + 1.08 + 1.11 - 37.56) / 37.56 = (50.32 - 37.56)/37.56 = 12.76/37.56 = 0.3397... = 33.97%. Need exact. Use figures: 48.13, 1.08, 1.11, 37.56. Compute: 48.13+1.08+1.11=50.32; minus 37.56=12.76; divide by 37.56 = 0.33972... So ROI ~33.97%. The question asks "what is the roi" - likely percentage. Provide answer as 33.97% or 0.3397? Usually ROI as percentage. We'll output 33.97% inside answer. Evidence: 48.13 | Fiscal year-end per share price 2007; 37.56 | Fiscal year-end per share price 2005; 1.08 | Cash dividends paid per share 2006; 1.11 | Cash dividends paid per share 2007. Program: divide(subtract(add(add(48.13, 1.08), 1.11), 37.56), 37.56)
